test_title: PYST 19: SSC CGL - Reasoning (Held On : 21 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d44da4b22641a613ba96455e94ad3dd00a9557f5b0f6a271d32add2cc0fe2d96.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

1) The given figure series is rotate 135º anticlockwise in every next figure.

2) In the second figure star shift towards the first position then in third figure triangle shift toward the first position and at last figure square shift toward the first position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef14ccbfc17395ca73aaf6f6bc5654dbcedf947e04da922b8e2fe0936e5ec4cd.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
